adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained offset from ~478 to ~524 with clear opposing steps at both ends (drop at ~478, recovery at ~524) across all axes; P1 (476–518) truncates the return, P2 (479–526) extends slightly beyond observed recovery and includes post-recovery motion. Hypothesis P2 subtraction yields flatter residuals than P1, but interior observations (e.g., E-axis 500–520) still show persistent offset relative to pre-event level, confirming a genuine temporary platform. The best-supported interval is 478–524, not matching either candidate exactly; thus replace with refined range.
